name: QS Core Modules
author: Quantum Slice Corporation

sections.description:
This is an absolutely free plugin that takes care of most of the things we need to add to every installation we install. This plugin is built for speed and functionality and every module included is easily turned on and off via a settings page.

Features:

  • Built for speed – wont bog down your site
  • Easily customizable, every module has a settings page
  • Each module can be turned on or off with a single checkbox making sure your site does not load code it does not need

Modules:

  • REMOVE WP VERSIONS & BLOAT MODULE
    — Options to remove WordPress version numbers from RSS Feeds, Rest API, Meta Generator tag and enqueued scriptsand CSS files
    — Remove Emoji related JS and code from front end and admin pages
    — Limit post revisions to debloat database for speed
    — Disable XMLRPC access for security
    — Disable WP-JSON access for security

  • ADD HEADER/FOOTER CODE MODULE
    — Abillity to add scripts and tags to your section and just before the closing tag
    — Useful for adding analytics tags or any custom CSS/JS code

  • ADD PHP MODULE
    — Ability for admins to add PHP files on the server and load / run them via a shortcode anywhere on any page

  • MAINTENANCE MODE MODULE
    — Turn on Maintenance Mode that will display a custom “Site Under Mainentance” message to all visitors
    — Customizable maintenance message to display to visitors
    — Allows anyone logged in as an Admin to still view site for testing
    — Allows logins even when in maintenance mode to prevent being locked out

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the plugin via the settings page, or use any relevant shortcodes.
sections.faq:
Do all modules run and waste resources if not enabled?

No, if you disable a module its code does not load or run.

Is this free?

Yes, Completely. But donations are always welcome!

Why are the settings pages so plain?

This plugin is built for speed and utility, not to be pretty. No extra stylesheets or extraneous code is loaded.
